title: How I made a cinematic lore teaser for my indie game using AI video tools (on a zero budget)
author: AccidentWhole493
selftext:
Creating cinematic lore trailers for games usually requires hiring 3D animators or spending months in Unreal Engine. As a solo dev, I didn't have the time or money for that.

For my indie narrative game, I needed a few quick dramatic teaser clips showing the protagonist reacting to plot twists in a vertical format for TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

I used APOB AI's character consistency and story-generation features to lock down my main character's design. Then I generated a series of dramatic dialogue scenes that matched the game's atmosphere.

Being able to keep the character's facial features and clothing consistent across 5 different shots saved me from the typical "AI morphing nightmare." It allowed me to ship a 30-second lore teaser in one afternoon.

If you're making narrative games and need quick marketing assets, it’s worth a look to test out storyboards.
